item.title: Getting Free Analysis from Games on Chess.com with Lichessify
item.description: I have been playing like, a normal amount of chess lately. I’m not yet past the “don’t just move your queen to her death” phase yet, but I have noticeably gotten better since I rage-quit last year against my little brother.
